message: Full chemical recipes are not disclosed. The 100% certification-description row is not an ingredient or a formula.
Representative sample certificate has no lot number. INCI lists iron oxide CI 77491 and CAS 1345-25-1; assay/footer say Fe3O4 and CI 77499. Supplier clarification needed.
Uploaded summaries are not verified regulations. All extracted rows are disabled for decisions. Verify scope, units, current edition, effective dates and authoritative sources before activation.
Do not compare borax ingredient percentage directly to a boron migration threshold. Compound content, elemental content and laboratory migration are different measurements.
Supplier assay ranges are raw-material specifications, not maximum allowed use levels in a finished product. Reported <= values are upper bounds.
